Dear Sirs,

We are Patent Attorneys and Advocates for Thermonix Innovations Pvt Ltd, Pune, the registered owner of Indian Patent No. 398214 titled 'Adaptive Compressor Speed Control Method for Inverter Air Conditioners', valid until 2039.

Our client has purchased and tested the Nexora 1.5 Ton 5-Star Inverter Split AC (Model NX-AC155I) and finds that its compressor control firmware implements each element of claims 1, 4 and 7 of the said patent. Claim charts are enclosed.

2. Provide an account of units sold since January 2025, and

A written response is required within 45 days from this notice. If we do not hear from you, our client will file an infringement suit before the Bombay High Court seeking injunction, damages and delivery up of infringing goods.
